srList.sentence: Patients Eligible patients were >=40 years of age and were current or former smokers with a diagnosis of COPD, pre- and post-albuterol forced expiratory volume in 1 secondforced vital capacity (FEV1FVC) ratio <0.7, post-albuterol FEV1 of >=30-<=80 predicted (corresponding to GOLD grade 2 or 3), COPD Assessment Test (CAT) score >=10, and <=1 moderate and no severe exacerbations in the previous year.

srList.sentence: Materials and Methods Study Design The multicenter, double-blind, double-dummy, 3-arm parallel-group EMAX trial randomized patients 1:1:1 to 24 weeks of UMECVI (62.525 ug) once daily via the ELLIPTA inhaler, UMEC (62.5 ug) once daily via ELLIPTA, or SAL (50 ug) twice-daily via the DISKUS inhaler.
